# Bijasa

> Bijasa is a software engineering company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. It designs and builds software of every kind, from idea to launch: web platforms, desktop and mobile apps, business and operations systems, APIs and integrations, cloud and DevOps, data engineering and AI. Bijasa also makes its own products.

## Company facts

- Name: Bijasa. Website: https://bijasa.com. Email: hello@bijasa.com. Phone: +91 88061 09348.
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India. Works with clients remotely and in person.
- Official profiles: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/bijasa/ and GitHub https://github.com/bijasa.
- Services: custom software development, web and mobile app development, desktop applications, cloud platforms and DevOps, data engineering and AI, UI/UX design, maintenance and support.
- Philosophy: software built from the roots up. Bijasa learns how the work really runs and settles the foundations (data model, permissions, integrations, failure cases, tests) before the screens, so software can last, change and grow.
- Sectors Bijasa works across: fintech and payments, healthcare, logistics and supply chain, climate and energy, commerce and retail, education.
- How Bijasa works: understand, shape, build, grow. Clients see working software early, and scope and cost are agreed before work starts.

## Products made by Bijasa

- [Bijasa Invoice](https://invoicing.bijasa.com/): a free web platform for invoices, quotations and business documents. No signup; records stay in the user's browser.
- [Bijasa Typing](https://typing.bijasa.com/): free typing practice and mock tests for Indian government exams, in English, Hindi and Marathi.
- [Bijadex](https://github.com/bijasa/bijadex-releases/releases/latest): a desktop billing and stock app for retail counters (Windows and Mac), with barcode scanning, GST bills, UPI and credit (khata).
- GearShift: an operations system for service workshops that tracks every job from check-in to handover. Demos on request.
